<observations>
Date: May 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) Kitchen remodel budget: $28,500.
* 🟡 (12:45) Remodel planning: BrightBuild Co. walkthrough, countertop quotes compiled, StoneCraft quartz lead time verified, pull-out trash bin added, demolition tentatively set.
* ✅ (19:35) Revised quote package emailed to user.

Date: May 16, 2026
* 🔴 (10:15) Upgrades added: under-cabinet LED strips (BrightGlow Supplies), 900 CFM range hood ($2,750 via VentMaster Inc.), quartz windowsill, and **Sea Glass** backsplash tile (updating earlier Fog Gray).
* ✅ (16:15) Visual mock-up PDF of quartz windowsill sent; follow-up call scheduled for May 19.

Date: May 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:10) Selected matte black faucet (AquaFlow) and noted teal accent paint.
* 🟡 (09:30) Demolition postponed until flooring arrives; crew arrival set for 08:00-09:00.
* ✅ (11:15) StoneEdge Fabricators confirmed quartz slab shipment (ETA June 5, 9'x2'); HOA permit approved.

Date: May 22, 2026
* 🔴 (08:35) Selected "Honey Oak Classic" flooring (250 sq ft, FloorCraft, ETA June 12) and "Soft Sand" upper cabinet paint (ColorHue). Backsplash: 12.5 sq ft MarbleMist.
* 🟡 (09:25) Electrical rough-in scheduled for June 3 with Marco Ruiz.
* ✅ (12:20) HOA permit officially approved, clearing final ordering.

Date: May 26, 2026
* 🔴 (09:05) Ceiling height 9'2"; selected "Cascade Ridge" waterfall edge for island quartzite. Pantry door to become sliding glass panel (VistaGlide).
* 🟡 (10:15) Demolition rescheduled to June 20 with Luis Ortega. Sink: "AquaPure 24".
* ✅ (13:15) Electrical permit amendment for additional outlets approved.

Date: May 30, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) Island length 9'4"; ordered "Midnight Slate" quartzite (RiverStone, delivery Aug 5). Added built-in wine cooler ("Vintner 24"). Cabinet delivery set for July 2.
* 🟡 (11:10) EcoFlow Plumbing scheduled for July 18 sink install; frosted glass pantry panel ordered (ClearView Glassworks, arrival July 12). Walls to be "Soft Almond".
* ✅ (13:30) Electrical layout updated with Miller & Co. (GFCI outlets added).
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Managing kitchen remodel selections, scheduling contractors, and tracking material orders (cabinets arriving July 2, quartzite Aug 5, plumbing July 18).
- Secondary: Awaiting next steps or further user instructions on the remodel.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"I've updated the project timeline and orders with your latest selections, including the Midnight Slate quartzite, Vintner 24 wine cooler, and July 2 cabinet delivery. Would you like to review the schedule or focus on any remaining details?"
</suggested-response>
